items.title: Visa adds Monad to stablecoin settlement options
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses Visa (V) adding Monad as yet another option for settlecoin settlements. Visa already allows settlements on ethereum (ETH-USD), Solana (SOL-USD), and Avalanche (AVAX-USD).

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Wall Street hits the night shift thanks to Okxice, and Kraken puts daq in your wallet
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses Okxice's plans for a Nov. 23 launch under an SEC innovation exemption; Kraken (KRAK.PVT) to launch Nasdaq-backed tokenized versions of European stocks; and Goldman Sachs (GS) and Citi (C) among the banks committing to stablecoin ventures.

items.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi commit millions to stablecoin venture: What to know
items.summary: Goldman Sachs, Citi, and other banks are committing $270 million to a stablecoin venture called "Project Faro." Scott Melker outlines what you need to know.

items.title: Can Visa's Monad Integration Boost Its Stablecoin Strategy?
items.summary: V expands its stablecoin settlement network with Monad, enhancing blockchain flexibility as settlement volumes surge and institutional adoption gains momentum.
